device.name: Antelope Discrete 4 Pro Synergy Core
device.notes: vid copied from Orion Studio III on the assumption it's Antelope's registered USB vendor id (constant across their product line) -- NOT independently confirmed for this device. Verify with `lsusb -v` or a capture before trusting it. pid and bcdDevice are taken directly from the device's own descriptor table (see project notes) and should be correct as-is. A unit with serial REDACTED is the one this profile is being built against; serial is per-unit, not part of the protocol, and is not read/used anywhere in transport.py or protocol.py.

transport.notes: Copied none of Orion Studio III's transport values on purpose -- report size, endpoints, and poll interval are device-specific and haven't been captured for this unit yet. Fill these in from a real capture per README.md 'Adding a new Antelope device' before anything in this profile can be used. Don't assume 320-byte reports; a Discrete-series device may use a different report size entirely.

command.notes: SET_PARAM shape (magic/opcode/param_id_offset/channel_offset/value_offset) not yet captured for this device. Do not assume it matches Orion Studio III's 0x70/0x13/16/17/18 -- confirm from a fresh capture first, per README.md step 4 (check the outgoing URB_INTERRUPT out frame, not just the state-report diff).

state_report.notes: magic byte and gain/status base offsets not yet captured. Follow the same capture-correlate-confirm discipline as Orion Studio III's gain_base_offset/status_base_offset (see that profile's params for the pattern to replicate here).

channels.notes: Physical input channel count not yet confirmed for this device -- check the product's spec sheet and a capture before filling in.

buses.notes: Output bus ids (monitor A/B, headphone, etc.) not yet captured for this device -- do not assume Orion Studio III's 0/1/2/5 mapping applies.
